headline: Dana needs a yes for Thursday before noon, and Omer asks who can let the plumber in on Friday.

waiting.said: Morning! Are we still on for Thursday? I have to confirm the table by noon today or we lose it.
waiting.gist: Needs a yes for Thursday's dinner before noon
waiting.reply: Morning! Yes, still on for Thursday. Go ahead and book it. [Want me to bring anything?]

waiting.said: @maya can you be home on Friday between 10 and 12? The plumber can only come then and someone has to let him in.
waiting.gist: Asks if you can let the plumber in on Friday morning
waiting.reply: I can be home Friday from [10 to 12], I'll let him in. Can someone leave me the meter code?

waiting.said: Maya, are you hosting in November? We need to know by the weekend so we can pick the date.
waiting.gist: Wants to know if you're hosting in November
waiting.reply: Happy to host in November! [Which Thursday works for everyone?]

waiting.said: Send me a photo of the garden when you can, I want to see the new roses 🌹
waiting.gist: Wants a photo of the new roses
waiting.reply: Here they are! They finally opened this week. [attach the photo]

promises.said: I'll send you the photos from the wedding tonight, promise!
I'll bring the new bibs on Sunday
promises.gist: Bring the new bibs to Sunday's game

decided.gist: Sunday's game moves to 10:00 at the school pitch
Next month's book is Klara and the Sun
Rent goes up from November, split the same way as now
